content.rendered: This is to invite you to webcast NetFlow-lite: Enable Data Center-wide Monitoring which is scheduled for Tuesday, 06-28-2011. I will be speaking  about NetFlow-lite together with the key Cisco people who worked with me at this project. Hope you will join the workshop!
